clusters.name: your grandmother Hazel's Parkinson's diagnosis, 1986–1996
clusters.reason: Around your grandmother Hazel's diagnosis in September 1986, within a decade: your grandfather Ambrose began to overfunction in her care; your father Duncan's anxiety over her rose; he and his uncle Lyle argued over who should help their parents; Duncan's drinking rose through the early 1990s; and he and your mother fought over his evenings at his parents' house.
